title: SIMON shared definitions
description: Grammars every SIMON schema uses (spec/PROTOCOL.md section 2 and Appendix A). Lengths and rules a regular expression cannot state are given in each description.

address.description: A version 2 address, local@domain, in lower case (PROTOCOL.md 2.1). The local part is at most 64 bytes, the domain at most 253, and the domain's last label is not all digits.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 in UTC, whole seconds or exactly three fractional digits, naming a real calendar moment (PROTOCOL.md 2.5).

messageId.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the canonical message without its signature.

keyToken.description: An algorithm name, a colon, and the raw public key in base64url: ed25519:... or ml-dsa-65:... (PROTOCOL.md 2.3).

principal.description: A principal's identifier: mailto:, tel: (E.164) or simon-key: (PROTOCOL.md 2.2).

origin.description: A server origin, https://host[:port] (PROTOCOL.md 3). Development servers may use http:, never by default.

headerName.description: A name: hyphen-joined lower-case labels, several joined by dots for a private reverse-domain name (PROTOCOL.md 5.4).

mediaType.description: A lower-case type/subtype with optional parameters (PROTOCOL.md 5.3).

keyEntry.description: Public key history entry. Current documents contain at most 32 total entries. Retained history may be pruned and does not promise perpetual verification. Private device labels are not public key projection members.

claim.description: A statement a carrier makes about a message's author (PROTOCOL.md 6.2). acts-for has agent, for, verifiedAt and scope; other types are the registry's.
